exposure: post-partum anaemia due to acute blood loss
cohort: 1,558,752 women giving birth in Sweden between 1997 and 2012
finding: Maternal obesity, obstetric interventions (induction of labor, caesarean section), and postpartum anemia due to acute blood loss were associated with an increased risk of diagnosed postpartum sepsis.
mod_finding: Caesarean section, whether overall or elective, was associated with an increased risk of postpartum sepsis compared to vaginal delivery.
